decisions.reason: Because this waterproof lined safety shoe range was only visible on the website in its launch year, it appears to have had limited market traction, and escalation pressures are weak since it is an incremental extension rather than a highly visible strategic commitment.

This electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe looks like a close-to-core but not central innovation that disappeared from public presentation after 2019, so by 2022 management would likely stop backing it and reallocate resources.

Although a safety shoe series fits the core business, its absence from the website after 2019 suggests disappointing follow-through, and the firm's broad portfolio makes it more likely to cut this line once justification for continued commitment weakens.
